manifest.platform: Linux x86_64; pinned Debian Python image; GIL CPython 3.13.15
manifest.release_scope: Original native foundation; full language conformance remains separate

scope.supported: Basic construction, Send(name/item), demonstrated argument syntax and catalog encoding, ordinary sequential lists with actual partial failures, confirmation and explicit recovery.
scope.open: Full BuildTC/Send and command argument types/casting, GCS sequences, scheduling, load-only, critical confirmation, platform addInfo, atomic Group/Block and combined telemetry/limit behavior are not qualified.
scope.unsupported_blocks: Before-effect rejection is regression evidence only, not support for Block or its example/section.
scope.failure_oracle: Actual simulator SAFE mode: CMD2 succeeds, CMD1 has RELEASE/FAILED, CMD3 remains unsent. Both automatic cancellation and native ABORT/RESEND/SKIP/CANCEL action prompt are asserted.
scope.uncertain_effects: Retained separately by original driver and native DSS regression suites; known false receipts and unknown outcomes are not interchangeable.
